LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Last night's typhoon was truly terrifying.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 家豪
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 是啊！這次的強烈颱風不但風大雨大，而且來的速度突然變快，讓人來不及準備。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 是啊！这次的强烈台风不但风大雨大，而且来的速度突然变快，让人来不及准备。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Shì a! Zhè cì de qiángliè táifēng búdàn fēng dà yǔ dà, érqiě lái de sùdù tūrán biàn kuài, ràng rén láibùjí zhǔnbèi.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Jiahao: Yeah! This strong typhoon not only brought heavy winds and rain, but also sped up so suddenly that people didn't have time to prepare.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 前天的新聞只說這個颱風離臺灣不遠，要大家注意，沒想到來得這麼快。你家沒事吧？
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 前天的新闻只说这个台风离台湾不远，要大家注意，没想到来得这么快。你家没事吧？
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Qiántiān de xīnwén zhǐ shuō zhè ge táifēng lí Táiwān bù yuǎn, yào dàjiā zhùyì, méi xiǎngdào lái de zhème kuài. Nǐ jiā méi shì ba?
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: The news the day before yesterday only said this typhoon wasn't far from Taiwan and warned everyone to pay attention; who knew it would come so fast. Is your home okay?

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 家豪
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 屋子裡還好，可是社區周圍有很多樹木被吹倒了，馬路兩旁的路燈也被吹壞了，而且我住的這棟樓整晚都停電。妳家呢？
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 屋子里还好，可是社区周围有很多树木被吹倒了，马路两旁的路灯也被吹坏了，而且我住的这栋楼整晚都停电。你家呢？
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wūzi lǐ háihǎo, kěshì shèqū zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō shùmù bèi chuīdǎo le, mǎlù liǎngpáng de lùdēng yě bèi chuīhuài le, érqiě wǒ zhù de zhè dòng lóu zhěngwǎn dōu tíngdiàn. Nǐ jiā ne?
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Jiahao: Inside the house is fine, but around the neighborhood lots of trees were blown down, streetlamps along the road were smashed, and the building I live in had a blackout all night. How about yours?

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我家還好。因為外面淹水，家裡螞蟻多了一點。鄰居的運氣就沒這麼好，他們家被破壞得很嚴重，連屋頂都飛了。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我家还好。因为外面淹水，家里蚂蚁多了一点。邻居的运气就没这么好，他们家被破坏得很严重，连屋顶都飞了。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ jiā háihǎo. Yīnwèi wàimiàn yānshuǐ, jiā lǐ mǎyǐ duō le yìdiǎn. Línjū de yùnqì jiù méi zhème hǎo, tāmen jiā bèi pòhuài de hěn yánzhòng, lián wūdǐng dōu fēi le.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: My home is okay. Because of flooding outside, there are a few more ants inside. The neighbors weren't as lucky; their house was severely damaged, and even their roof flew off.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 家豪
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 真是太糟糕了！那很難整理吧？
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 真是太糟糕了！那很难整理吧？
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Zhēn shì tài zāogāo le! Nà hěn nán zhěnglǐ ba?
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Jiahao: That's terrible! It must be very hard to clean up?

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 是啊。收音機的廣播說，東部有一些地區發生水災，很多房子塌了，住在那裡的人還得離開家，住到安全的地方去。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 是啊。收音机的广播说，东部有一些地区发生水灾，很多房子塌了，住在那里的人还得离开家，住到安全的地方去。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Shì a. Shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō shuō, dōngbù yǒu yìxiē dìqū fāshēng shuǐzāi, hěn duō fángzi tā le, zhù zài nàlǐ de rén hái děi líkāi jiā, zhù dào ānquán de dìfang qù.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Yes. The radio broadcast said flooding occurred in some eastern regions; many houses collapsed, and people living there had to leave home to stay in safe places.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 家豪
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我昨天晚上沒辦法看電視，手機也沒電，所以不知道最新的消息。沒想到東部的情況這麼嚴重。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我昨天晚上没办法看电视，手机也没电，所以不知道最新的消息。没想到东部的情况这么严重。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang méi bànfǎ kàn diànshì, shǒujī yě méi diàn, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào zuìxīn de xiāoxi. Méi xiǎngdào dōngbù de qíngkuàng zhème yánzhòng.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Jiahao: Last night I couldn't watch TV and my phone was out of power, so I didn't know the latest news. I didn't realize the eastern situation was so severe.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 聽說還有一個颱風要來，跟臺灣的距離只有一千公里。我看你最好準備個收音機，這樣停電時也能聽到颱風的最新消息。還有，要注意門窗有沒有問題，萬一被颱風吹壞，造成意外就麻煩了。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 听说还有一个台风要来，跟台湾的距离只有一千公里。我看你最好准备个收音机，这样停电时也能听到台风的最新消息。还有，要注意门窗有没有问题，万一被台风吹坏，造成意外就麻烦了。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Tīngshuō hái yǒu yí ge táifēng yào lái, gēn Táiwān de jùlí zhǐyǒu yìqiān gōnglǐ. Wǒ kàn nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔnbèi ge shōuyīnjī, zhèyàng tíngdiàn shí yě néng tīngdào táifēng de zuìxīn xiāoxi. Hái yǒu, yào zhùyì ménchuāng yǒu méi yǒu wèntí, wànyī bèi táifēng chuīhuài, zàochéng yìwài jiù máfan le.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: I heard another typhoon is coming, only 1,000 kilometers from Taiwan. I think you'd better get a radio ready, so that during a blackout you can still hear the latest typhoon updates. Also, check if there are problems with windows and doors; in case they get broken by the typhoon and cause accidents, it will be troublesome.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 家豪
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 好，我知道了。提到收音機，讓我想起小時候，有一次來了個大颱風，一連下了好幾天的大雨。停電的時候，我們一家人點著蠟燭坐在收音機旁，一邊聽著廣播，一邊聽著外面的風雨聲，那種感覺到現在都忘不了。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 好，我知道了。提到收音机，让我想起小时候，有一次来了个大台风，一连下了好几天的大雨。停电的时候，我们一家人点着蜡烛坐在收音机旁，一边听着广播，一边听着外面的风雨声，那种感觉到现在都忘不了。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zhīdào le. Tídào shōuyīnjī, ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhou, yǒu yí cì lái le ge dà táifēng, yìlián xià le hǎojǐ tiān de dàyǔ. Tíngdiàn de shíhou, wǒmen yì jiā rén diǎn zhe làzhú zuò zài shōuyīnjī páng, yìbiān tīng zhe guǎngbō, yìbiān tīng zhe wàimiàn de fēngyǔshēng, nà zhǒng gǎnjué dào xiànzài dōu wàng buliǎo.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Jiahao: Okay, got it. Mentioning radios reminds me of my childhood: once a huge typhoon hit and it rained hard for several days in a row. During the blackout, our whole family lit candles and sat by the radio, listening to the broadcast while hearing the wind and rain outside; that feeling is unforgettable even now.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我也記得小時候晚上一停電就點蠟燭。有一次鄰居點蠟燭時不小心，差點就引起火災，把大家嚇了一跳。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我也记得小时候晚上一停电就点蜡烛。有一次邻居点蜡烛时不小心，差点就引起火灾，把大家吓了一跳。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ yě jìde xiǎoshíhou wǎnshang yì tíngdiàn jiù diǎn làzhú. Yǒu yí cì línjū diǎn làzhú shí bù xiǎoxīn, chàdiǎn jiù yǐnqǐ huǒzāi, bǎ dàjiā xià le yí tiào.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: I also remember lighting candles whenever power went out at night in my childhood. Once a neighbor wasn't careful when lighting a candle and almost caused a fire, which gave everyone quite a scare.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 家豪
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 點蠟燭真的得很小心。對了，我等一下要去超市看看。每次颱風一來，蔬菜水果的價格就提高了，而且不一定買得到。妳最好也先準備一些吃的。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 点蜡烛真的得很小心。对了，我等一下要去超市看看。每次台风一来，蔬菜水果的价格就提高了，而且不一定买得到。你最好也先准备一些吃的。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Diǎn làzhú zhēnde děi hěn xiǎoxīn. Duì le, wǒ děng yíxià yào qù chāoshì kànkan. Měi cì táifēng yì lái, shūcài shuǐguǒ de jiàgé jiù tígāo le, érqiě bù yídìng mǎi de dào. Nǐ zuìhǎo yě xiān zhǔnbèi yìxiē chī de.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Jiahao: One really must be careful with candles. By the way, I'm heading to the supermarket soon. Whenever a typhoon hits, fruit and vegetable prices jump, and you might not even be able to get them. You'd better stock up on some food too.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 我早就買好了。剛來臺灣的時候，我以為隨時去超市都買得到新鮮的蔬菜，沒想到新聞一說颱風要來，不但變貴了，還被搶光了。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 我早就买好了。刚来台湾的时候，我以为随时去超市都买得到新鲜的蔬菜，没想到新闻一说台风要来，不但变贵了，还被抢光了。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Wǒ zǎojiù mǎi hǎo le. Gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, wǒ yǐwéi suíshí qù chāoshì dōu mǎi de dào xīnxiān de shūcài, méi xiǎngdào xīnwén yì shuō táifēng yào lái, búdàn biàn guì le, hái bèi qiǎng guāng le.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: I bought mine long ago. When I first came to Taiwan, I thought one could always buy fresh vegetables at the supermarket at any time; who knew that as soon as the news said a typhoon was coming, not only did prices rise, but everything was snatched up clean.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 家豪
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 所以颱風來以前，應該先把食物準備好。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 所以台风来以前，应该先把食物准备好。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Suǒyǐ táifēng lái yǐqián, yīnggāi xiān bǎ shíwù zhǔnbèi hǎo.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Jiahao: So before a typhoon arrives, one should prepare food first.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 芳草
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.traditional: 沒錯。不過，你還是先買收音機，再去超市吧。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.simplified: 没错。不过，你还是先买收音机，再去超市吧。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Méi cuò. Búguò, nǐ háishì xiān mǎi shōuyīnjī, zài qù chāoshì ba.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Fangcao: Exactly. Still, you'd better buy the radio first before heading to the supermarket.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.speaker: 家豪
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.pinyin: Yě hǎo. Wǒmen xià cì zài liáo.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_ONE.english: Jiahao: Sounds good. Let's chat next time.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 臺灣、印尼、日本等海島國家，整年大小地震不斷。研究人員認為，地震的主要原因是地理位置在太平洋周圍的關係。對住在這個地帶的人來說，地震好像是很平常的事情。不過，一九九九年九月二十一日，半夜一點四十七分，臺灣發生了一場規模七點三的強烈地震。地震發生時，讓臺灣人感覺到非常害怕。大約過了三十分鐘，又發生了規模六點七的地震，結果造成了非常嚴重的災情。一直到現在，人們還是忘不了那個可怕的夜晚。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 台湾、印尼、日本等海岛国家，整年大小地震不断。研究人员认为，地震的主要原因是地理位置在太平洋周围的关系。对住在这个地带的人来说，地震好像是很平常的事情。不过，一九九九年九月二十一日，半夜一点四十七分，台湾发生了一场规模七点三的强烈地震。地震发生时，让台湾人感觉到非常害怕。大约过了三十分钟，又发生了规模六点七的地震，结果造成了非常严重的灾情。一直到现在，人们还是忘不了那个可怕的夜晚。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Táiwān, Yìnní, Rìběn děng hǎidǎo guójiā, zhěng nián dàxiǎo dìzhèn búduàn. Yánjiū rényuán rènwéi, dìzhèn de zhǔyào yuányīn shì dìlǐ wèizhì zài Tàipíngyáng zhōuwéi de guānxi. Duì zhù zài zhè ge dìdài de rén lái shuō, dìzhèn hǎoxiàng shì hěn píngcháng de shìqing. Búguò, yī jiǔ jiǔ jiǔ nián jiǔ yuè èrshíyī rì, bànyè yì diǎn sìshíqī fēn, Táiwān fāshēng le yì chǎng guīmó qī diǎn sān de qiángliè dìzhèn. Dìzhèn fāshēng shí, ràng Táiwānrén gǎnjué dào fēicháng hàipà. Dàyuē guò le sānshí fēnzhōng, yòu fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn qī de dìzhèn, jiéguǒ zàochéng le fēicháng yánzhòng de zāiqíng. Yìzhí dào xiànzài, rénmen háishì wàng buliǎo nà ge kěpà de yèwǎn.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: Island nations such as Taiwan, Indonesia, and Japan experience continuous earthquakes of all sizes throughout the year. Researchers believe the primary cause of earthquakes is their geographical location around the Pacific Ocean. To people living in this zone, earthquakes seem to be quite ordinary. However, on September 21, 1999, at 1:47 a.m., Taiwan experienced a powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake. When the earthquake struck, it made Taiwanese people feel terrified. About thirty minutes later, another magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck, resulting in extremely severe devastation. Even now, people still cannot forget that terrifying night.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 那一夜，中部山區有許多大石頭從山上掉了下來，不但路不通，甚至還有人被困在塌下來的屋子或石頭底下。許多人親眼看見這樣的情況，但是沒辦法把人救出來，只能向警察或軍人求救。不久，救災人員和軍隊都到達了災區，不少國外的專業人員也都趕到臺灣，大家把力量集合起來，很有耐心地找出被困的人。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 那一夜，中部山区有许多大石头从山上掉了下来，不但路不通，甚至还有人被困在塌下来的屋子或石头底下。许多人亲眼看见这样的情况，但是没办法把人救出来，只能向警察或军人求救。不久，救灾人员和军队都到达了灾区，不少国外的专业人员也都赶到台湾，大家把力量集合起来，很有耐心地找出被困的人。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Nà yí yè, zhōngbù shānqū yǒu xǔduō dà shítóu cóng shānshàng diào le xiàlai, búdàn lù bù tōng, shènzhì hái yǒurén bèi kùn zài tā xiàlai de wūzi huò shítóu dǐxia. Xǔduō rén qīnyǎn kànjiàn zhèyàng de qíngkuàng, dànshì méi bànfǎ bǎ rén jiù chūlai, zhǐ néng xiàng jǐngchá huò jūnrén qiújiù. Bùjiǔ, jiùzāi rényuán hàn jūnduì dōu dàodá le zāiqū, bù shǎo guówài de zhuānyè rényuán yě dōu gǎndào Táiwān, dàjiā bǎ lìliàng jíhé qǐlai, hěn yǒu nàixīn de zhǎochū bèi kùn de rén.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: That night, in the central mountainous area, many huge boulders fell from the mountains; not only were roads blocked, but some people were even trapped under collapsed houses or rocks. Many people saw this situation with their own eyes, but had no way to rescue the victims, and could only call for help from police or soldiers. Soon, disaster relief personnel and troops arrived in the disaster area, and quite a few overseas specialists also rushed to Taiwan; everyone combined their efforts and patiently searched for the trapped survivors.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 地震過後沒多久，人們發現中部以北和以南的地方也有不少災情，所以天還沒亮，許多民眾就開著卡車，把水、食物、電池等資源送到災區，親自發給需要的人。那段時間，因為大家有錢出錢、有力出力，發揮了互相幫助的精神，所以才能讓災民很快地恢復正常的生活。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 地震过后没多久，人们发现中部以北和以南的地方也有不少灾情，所以天还没亮，许多民众就开着卡车，把水、食物、电池等资源送到灾区，亲自发给需要的人。那段时间，因为大家有钱出钱、有力出力，发挥了互相帮助的精神，所以才能让灾民很快地恢复正常的生活。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu méi duōjiǔ, rénmen fāxiàn zhōngbù yǐ běi hàn yǐ nán de dìfang yě yǒu bù shǎo zāiqíng, suǒyǐ tiān hái méi liàng, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù kāi zhe kǎchē, bǎ shuǐ, shíwù, diànchí děng zīyuán sòng dào zāiqū, qīnzì fā gěi xūyào de rén. Nà duàn shíjiān, yīnwèi dàjiā yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, suǒyǐ cái néng ràng zāimín hěn kuài de huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: Not long after the earthquake, people found that areas north and south of the central region also suffered considerable damage; therefore before dawn, many citizens drove trucks to deliver water, food, batteries, and other resources to the disaster area, personally distributing them to people in need. During that period, because everyone contributed money if they had money, and effort if they had effort, embodying the spirit of mutual help, the victims were able to quickly resume normal life.

LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.speaker: 旁白
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.traditional: 經過九二一大地震以後，臺灣比以前更重視地震教育，希望這樣能降低災情，人們不要再因為地震而失去了寶貴的生命。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.simplified: 经过九二一大地震以后，台湾比以前更重视地震教育，希望这样能降低灾情，人们不要再因为地震而失去了宝贵的生命。
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.pinyin: Jīngguò Jiǔ'èryī dà dìzhèn yǐhòu, Táiwān bǐ yǐqián gèng zhòngshì dìzhèn jiàoyù, xīwàng zhèyàng néng jiàngdī zāiqíng, rénmen bú yào zài yīnwèi dìzhèn ér shīqù le bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
LESSON_FIVE_DIALOGUE_TWO.english: Following the 921 Earthquake, Taiwan attached greater importance to earthquake education than before, hoping to reduce disaster impact so people will never again lose precious lives because of earthquakes.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 地震和颱風 · Earthquakes and Typhoons

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 昨晚的颱風真可怕。
lines.simplified: 昨晚的台风真可怕。
lines.pinyin: Zuówǎn de táifēng zhēn kěpà.
lines.english: Fangcao: Last night's typhoon was truly terrifying.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 是啊！這次的強烈颱風不但風大雨大，而且來的速度突然變快，讓人來不及準備。
lines.simplified: 是啊！这次的强烈台风不但风大雨大，而且来的速度突然变快，让人来不及准备。
lines.pinyin: Shì a! Zhè cì de qiángliè táifēng búdàn fēng dà yǔ dà, érqiě lái de sùdù tūrán biàn kuài, ràng rén láibùjí zhǔnbèi.
lines.english: Jiahao: Yeah! This strong typhoon not only brought heavy winds and rain, but also sped up so suddenly that people didn't have time to prepare.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 前天的新聞只說這個颱風離臺灣不遠，要大家注意，沒想到來得這麼快。你家沒事吧？
lines.simplified: 前天的新闻只说这个台风离台湾不远，要大家注意，没想到来得这么快。你家没事吧？
lines.pinyin: Qiántiān de xīnwén zhǐ shuō zhè ge táifēng lí Táiwān bù yuǎn, yào dàjiā zhùyì, méi xiǎngdào lái de zhème kuài. Nǐ jiā méi shì ba?
lines.english: Fangcao: The news the day before yesterday only said this typhoon wasn't far from Taiwan and warned everyone to pay attention; who knew it would come so fast. Is your home okay?

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 屋子裡還好，可是社區周圍有很多樹木被吹倒了，馬路兩旁的路燈也被吹壞了，而且我住的這棟樓整晚都停電。妳家呢？
lines.simplified: 屋子里还好，可是社区周围有很多树木被吹倒了，马路两旁的路灯也被吹坏了，而且我住的这栋楼整晚都停电。你家呢？
lines.pinyin: Wūzi lǐ háihǎo, kěshì shèqū zhōuwéi yǒu hěn duō shùmù bèi chuīdǎo le, mǎlù liǎngpáng de lùdēng yě bèi chuīhuài le, érqiě wǒ zhù de zhè dòng lóu zhěngwǎn dōu tíngdiàn. Nǐ jiā ne?
lines.english: Jiahao: Inside the house is fine, but around the neighborhood lots of trees were blown down, streetlamps along the road were smashed, and the building I live in had a blackout all night. How about yours?

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我家還好。因為外面淹水，家裡螞蟻多了一點。鄰居的運氣就沒這麼好，他們家被破壞得很嚴重，連屋頂都飛了。
lines.simplified: 我家还好。因为外面淹水，家里蚂蚁多了一点。邻居的运气就没这么好，他们家被破坏得很严重，连屋顶都飞了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiā háihǎo. Yīnwèi wàimiàn yānshuǐ, jiā lǐ mǎyǐ duō le yìdiǎn. Línjū de yùnqì jiù méi zhème hǎo, tāmen jiā bèi pòhuài de hěn yánzhòng, lián wūdǐng dōu fēi le.
lines.english: Fangcao: My home is okay. Because of flooding outside, there are a few more ants inside. The neighbors weren't as lucky; their house was severely damaged, and even their roof flew off.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 真是太糟糕了！那很難整理吧？
lines.simplified: 真是太糟糕了！那很难整理吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn shì tài zāogāo le! Nà hěn nán zhěnglǐ ba?
lines.english: Jiahao: That's terrible! It must be very hard to clean up?

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 是啊。收音機的廣播說，東部有一些地區發生水災，很多房子塌了，住在那裡的人還得離開家，住到安全的地方去。
lines.simplified: 是啊。收音机的广播说，东部有一些地区发生水灾，很多房子塌了，住在那里的人还得离开家，住到安全的地方去。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō shuō, dōngbù yǒu yìxiē dìqū fāshēng shuǐzāi, hěn duō fángzi tā le, zhù zài nàlǐ de rén hái děi líkāi jiā, zhù dào ānquán de dìfang qù.
lines.english: Fangcao: Yes. The radio broadcast said flooding occurred in some eastern regions; many houses collapsed, and people living there had to leave home to stay in safe places.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 我昨天晚上沒辦法看電視，手機也沒電，所以不知道最新的消息。沒想到東部的情況這麼嚴重。
lines.simplified: 我昨天晚上没办法看电视，手机也没电，所以不知道最新的消息。没想到东部的情况这么严重。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang méi bànfǎ kàn diànshì, shǒujī yě méi diàn, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào zuìxīn de xiāoxi. Méi xiǎngdào dōngbù de qíngkuàng zhème yánzhòng.
lines.english: Jiahao: Last night I couldn't watch TV and my phone was out of power, so I didn't know the latest news. I didn't realize the eastern situation was so severe.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 聽說還有一個颱風要來，跟臺灣的距離只有一千公里。我看你最好準備個收音機，這樣停電時也能聽到颱風的最新消息。還有，要注意門窗有沒有問題，萬一被颱風吹壞，造成意外就麻煩了。
lines.simplified: 听说还有一个台风要来，跟台湾的距离只有一千公里。我看你最好准备个收音机，这样停电时也能听到台风的最新消息。还有，要注意门窗有没有问题，万一被台风吹坏，造成意外就麻烦了。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō hái yǒu yí ge táifēng yào lái, gēn Táiwān de jùlí zhǐyǒu yìqiān gōnglǐ. Wǒ kàn nǐ zuìhǎo zhǔnbèi ge shōuyīnjī, zhèyàng tíngdiàn shí yě néng tīngdào táifēng de zuìxīn xiāoxi. Hái yǒu, yào zhùyì ménchuāng yǒu méi yǒu wèntí, wànyī bèi táifēng chuīhuài, zàochéng yìwài jiù máfan le.
lines.english: Fangcao: I heard another typhoon is coming, only 1,000 kilometers from Taiwan. I think you'd better get a radio ready, so that during a blackout you can still hear the latest typhoon updates. Also, check if there are problems with windows and doors; in case they get broken by the typhoon and cause accidents, it will be troublesome.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 好，我知道了。提到收音機，讓我想起小時候，有一次來了個大颱風，一連下了好幾天的大雨。停電的時候，我們一家人點著蠟燭坐在收音機旁，一邊聽著廣播，一邊聽著外面的風雨聲，那種感覺到現在都忘不了。
lines.simplified: 好，我知道了。提到收音机，让我想起小时候，有一次来了个大台风，一连下了好几天的大雨。停电的时候，我们一家人点着蜡烛坐在收音机旁，一边听着广播，一边听着外面的风雨声，那种感觉到现在都忘不了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zhīdào le. Tídào shōuyīnjī, ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ xiǎoshíhou, yǒu yí cì lái le ge dà táifēng, yìlián xià le hǎojǐ tiān de dàyǔ. Tíngdiàn de shíhou, wǒmen yì jiā rén diǎn zhe làzhú zuò zài shōuyīnjī páng, yìbiān tīng zhe guǎngbō, yìbiān tīng zhe wàimiàn de fēngyǔshēng, nà zhǒng gǎnjué dào xiànzài dōu wàng buliǎo.
lines.english: Jiahao: Okay, got it. Mentioning radios reminds me of my childhood: once a huge typhoon hit and it rained hard for several days in a row. During the blackout, our whole family lit candles and sat by the radio, listening to the broadcast while hearing the wind and rain outside; that feeling is unforgettable even now.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我也記得小時候晚上一停電就點蠟燭。有一次鄰居點蠟燭時不小心，差點就引起火災，把大家嚇了一跳。
lines.simplified: 我也记得小时候晚上一停电就点蜡烛。有一次邻居点蜡烛时不小心，差点就引起火灾，把大家吓了一跳。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě jìde xiǎoshíhou wǎnshang yì tíngdiàn jiù diǎn làzhú. Yǒu yí cì línjū diǎn làzhú shí bù xiǎoxīn, chàdiǎn jiù yǐnqǐ huǒzāi, bǎ dàjiā xià le yí tiào.
lines.english: Fangcao: I also remember lighting candles whenever power went out at night in my childhood. Once a neighbor wasn't careful when lighting a candle and almost caused a fire, which gave everyone quite a scare.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 點蠟燭真的得很小心。對了，我等一下要去超市看看。每次颱風一來，蔬菜水果的價格就提高了，而且不一定買得到。妳最好也先準備一些吃的。
lines.simplified: 点蜡烛真的得很小心。对了，我等一下要去超市看看。每次台风一来，蔬菜水果的价格就提高了，而且不一定买得到。你最好也先准备一些吃的。
lines.pinyin: Diǎn làzhú zhēnde děi hěn xiǎoxīn. Duì le, wǒ děng yíxià yào qù chāoshì kànkan. Měi cì táifēng yì lái, shūcài shuǐguǒ de jiàgé jiù tígāo le, érqiě bù yídìng mǎi de dào. Nǐ zuìhǎo yě xiān zhǔnbèi yìxiē chī de.
lines.english: Jiahao: One really must be careful with candles. By the way, I'm heading to the supermarket soon. Whenever a typhoon hits, fruit and vegetable prices jump, and you might not even be able to get them. You'd better stock up on some food too.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 我早就買好了。剛來臺灣的時候，我以為隨時去超市都買得到新鮮的蔬菜，沒想到新聞一說颱風要來，不但變貴了，還被搶光了。
lines.simplified: 我早就买好了。刚来台湾的时候，我以为随时去超市都买得到新鲜的蔬菜，没想到新闻一说台风要来，不但变贵了，还被抢光了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zǎojiù mǎi hǎo le. Gāng lái Táiwān de shíhou, wǒ yǐwéi suíshí qù chāoshì dōu mǎi de dào xīnxiān de shūcài, méi xiǎngdào xīnwén yì shuō táifēng yào lái, búdàn biàn guì le, hái bèi qiǎng guāng le.
lines.english: Fangcao: I bought mine long ago. When I first came to Taiwan, I thought one could always buy fresh vegetables at the supermarket at any time; who knew that as soon as the news said a typhoon was coming, not only did prices rise, but everything was snatched up clean.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 所以颱風來以前，應該先把食物準備好。
lines.simplified: 所以台风来以前，应该先把食物准备好。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ táifēng lái yǐqián, yīnggāi xiān bǎ shíwù zhǔnbèi hǎo.
lines.english: Jiahao: So before a typhoon arrives, one should prepare food first.

lines.speaker: 芳草
lines.traditional: 沒錯。不過，你還是先買收音機，再去超市吧。
lines.simplified: 没错。不过，你还是先买收音机，再去超市吧。
lines.pinyin: Méi cuò. Búguò, nǐ háishì xiān mǎi shōuyīnjī, zài qù chāoshì ba.
lines.english: Fangcao: Exactly. Still, you'd better buy the radio first before heading to the supermarket.

lines.speaker: 家豪
lines.traditional: 也好。我們下次再聊。
lines.simplified: 也好。我们下次再聊。
lines.pinyin: Yě hǎo. Wǒmen xià cì zài liáo.
lines.english: Jiahao: Sounds good. Let's chat next time.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express hypothetical low-probability emergencies and countermeasures using 萬一.
grammarPages.explanation: 「萬一」後面是可能性很小的假設，大多是不好的事情。
grammarPages.pattern: Condition / Prep + 萬一 + Contingency，(就/才) + Remedy

text.traditional: ……要注意門窗有沒有問題，萬一被颱風吹壞，造成意外就麻煩了。
text.simplified: ……要注意门窗有没有问题，万一被台风吹坏，造成意外就麻烦了。
text.pinyin: …… yào zhùyì ménchuāng yǒu méiyǒu wèntí, wànyī bèi táifēng chuīhuài, zàochéng yìwài jiù máfan le.
text.english: …Check the doors and windows for problems; if the typhoon damages them and causes an accident, it will be troublesome.

text.traditional: 出國旅遊前最好先買個旅遊平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外，就不必擔心了。
text.simplified: 出国旅游前最好先买个旅游平安保险，万一发生什么意外，就不必担心了。
text.pinyin: Chū guó lǚyóu qián zuì hǎo xiān mǎi ge lǚyóu píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài, jiù bú bì dānxīn le.
text.english: Before going abroad, it is best to buy travel insurance, so that if an accident happens you need not worry.

text.traditional: 我家裡平時都準備了一些蠟燭、電池什麼的，萬一停電了，才不會不方便。
text.simplified: 我家里平时都准备了一些蜡烛、电池什么的，万一停电了，才不会不方便。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lǐ píngshí dōu zhǔnbèi le yìxiē làzhú, diànchí shénme de, wànyī tíngdiàn le, cái bú huì bù fāngbiàn.
text.english: I usually keep candles, batteries and other supplies at home, so that a power outage will not cause inconvenience.

items.question: How does 萬一 differ from 如果 / 要是?
items.answer: 如果 / 要是 are neutral conditionals for any situation. 萬一 specifies a low-probability, typically undesirable event.
items.wrongTraditional: 萬一明天是晴天，我們就去爬山。
items.wrongSimplified: 万一明天是晴天，我们就去爬山。

right.traditional: 如果明天是晴天，我們就去爬山。
right.simplified: 如果明天是晴天，我们就去爬山。
right.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān shì qíngtiān, wǒmen jiù qù páshān.
right.english: If tomorrow is sunny, we will go hiking.

items.question: What conjunctions typically follow the 萬一 clause?
items.answer: 就 (for negative consequences) or 才 (for preventative actions that avert trouble).
items.wrongTraditional: 出門帶傘，萬一下雨而且淋濕。
items.wrongSimplified: 出门带伞，万一下雨而且淋湿。

right.traditional: 出門帶傘，萬一下雨才不會淋濕。
right.simplified: 出门带伞，万一下雨才不会淋湿。
right.pinyin: Chūmén dài sǎn, wànyī xiàyǔ cái bú huì línshī.
right.english: Take an umbrella when going out, so in case it rains you won't get soaked.

questions.correctFeedback: 萬一 introduces an unexpected risk to guard against.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 萬一 to express an emergency or undesirable possibility.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 萬一 is followed by a hypothesis with little possibility; mostly refers to bad things.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe an action or state occurring continuously without interruption using 一連.
grammarPages.explanation: 「一連」表示同一個動作或情況連續發生，後面接動詞或數量詞。例如：「他一連吃了五個包子」、「一連三天我都在家休息」。而否定詞「不」或「沒」只能用在數量詞後面的動詞，例如：「一連三天都沒下雨」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一連 + Verb / Num-M + Predicate

text.traditional: ……有一次來了個大颱風，一連下了好幾天的大雨。
text.simplified: ……有一次来了个大台风，一连下了好几天的大雨。
text.pinyin: …… yǒu yí cì lái le ge dà táifēng, yìlián xià le hǎojǐ tiān de dàyǔ.
text.english: …Once a big typhoon came, and it rained heavily for several days in a row.

text.traditional: 他一連說了好幾個我聽不懂的句子，他說的到底是哪國話啊？
text.simplified: 他一连说了好几个我听不懂的句子，他说的到底是哪国话啊？
text.pinyin: Tā yìlián shuō le hǎojǐ ge wǒ tīng bu dǒng de jùzi, tā shuō de dàodǐ shì nǎ guó huà a?
text.english: He said several sentences in a row that I could not understand; what language was he speaking?

words.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing

text.traditional: 我最近窮死了，已經一連兩個星期都吃泡麵了。
text.simplified: 我最近穷死了，已经一连两个星期都吃泡面了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn qióng sǐ le, yǐjīng yìlián liǎng ge xīngqī dōu chī pàomiàn le.
text.english: I have been dead broke recently and have already eaten instant noodles for two weeks in a row.

text.traditional: 他最近為了工作忙個不停，已經一連三天沒睡好覺了，精神很不好。
text.simplified: 他最近为了工作忙个不停，已经一连三天没睡好觉了，精神很不好。
text.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn wèile gōngzuò máng ge bù tíng, yǐjīng yìlián sān tiān méi shuì hǎo jiào le, jīngshén hěn bù hǎo.
text.english: He has been busy nonstop with work recently and has not slept well for three days in a row, so he is in poor spirits.

items.question: How does 一連 differ from 常常?
items.answer: 一連 means consecutively without any interruption. 常常 means frequently across distinct occasions.

right.pinyin: Tā yìlián sān tiān méi shuìjiào.
right.english: He went without sleep for three days straight.

items.question: Where is negation placed with 一連?
items.answer: Negation (沒/不) must appear after the quantifier phrase, directly before the verb: 一連三天沒下雨.

right.pinyin: Yìlián sān tiān méi chī dōngxi.
right.english: Didn't eat anything for three days straight.

tiles.meaning: rained three days in a row

questions.correctFeedback: 一連 denotes an unbroken consecutive sequence of three days of rain.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 一連 to express actions continuing unbroken in a row.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 一連 means that the same action or situation occurs continuously, followed by verbs and quantifiers. For example, 他一連吃了五個包子, 一連三天我都在家休息. The negative words 不 or 沒 can only be used on the verb after the quantifier, such as 一連三天都沒下雨.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Contrast a mistaken prior assumption with an unexpected reality using 以為……，沒想到……
grammarPages.explanation: 「以為」後面是說話者原本的想法，但和後面發生的事實不同。「沒想到」的後面是發生的事實，但發生前說話的人沒想過。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 以為 + Assumption，沒想到 + Reality

text.traditional: 我以為隨時去超市都買得到新鮮的蔬菜，沒想到新聞一說颱風要來……
text.simplified: 我以为随时去超市都买得到新鲜的蔬菜，没想到新闻一说台风要来……
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi suíshí qù chāoshì dōu mǎi de dào xīnxiān de shūcài, méi xiǎngdào xīnwén yì shuō táifēng yào lái……
text.english: I thought I could always get fresh vegetables at the supermarket, but unexpectedly, as soon as the news said a typhoon was coming…

words.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing

text.traditional: 我以為我不會看上那件深紅色的洋裝，沒想到看來看去，最後還是買了。
text.simplified: 我以为我不会看上那件深红色的洋装，没想到看来看去，最后还是买了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi wǒ bú huì kàn shàng nà jiàn shēn hóngsè de yángzhuāng, méi xiǎngdào kàn lái kàn qù, zuìhòu háishì mǎi le.
text.english: I thought I would not like that dark red dress, but after looking over and over, I bought it in the end.

text.traditional: 王媽媽以為這道菜孩子們一定會搶著吃，沒想到他們連嚐都不肯嚐。
text.simplified: 王妈妈以为这道菜孩子们一定会抢着吃，没想到他们连尝都不肯尝。
text.pinyin: Wáng māma yǐwéi zhè dào cài háizimen yídìng huì qiǎng zhe chī, méi xiǎngdào tāmen lián cháng dōu bù kěn cháng.
text.english: Mrs. Wang thought the children would scramble to eat this dish, but unexpectedly they would not even taste it.

words.pinyin: tāmen lián cháng dōu bù kěn cháng

items.question: How does 以為 differ from 認為 / 覺得?
items.answer: 以為 always implies that the prior belief was mistaken. 認為 and 覺得 describe opinions without implying falsity.
items.wrongTraditional: 我認為今天會下雨，沒想到是晴天。
items.wrongSimplified: 我认为今天会下雨，没想到是晴天。

right.traditional: 我以為今天會下雨，沒想到是晴天。
right.simplified: 我以为今天会下雨，没想到是晴天。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi jīntiān huì xiàyǔ, méi xiǎngdào shì qíngtiān.
right.english: I thought it would rain today, not expecting it to be sunny.

items.question: Can 沒想到 be replaced with 不料 or 誰知道?
items.answer: In formal or written Chinese, 不料 or 誰知 can be used, but in everyday spoken Chinese 沒想到 is standard.
items.wrongTraditional: 我以為他會來，可是他沒來了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我以为他会来，可是他没来了。

right.traditional: 我以為他會來，沒想到他沒來。
right.simplified: 我以为他会来，没想到他没来。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi tā huì lái, méi xiǎngdào tā méi lái.
right.english: I thought he would come, not expecting he wouldn't.

questions.correctFeedback: 以為 marks the mistaken assumption that contrasts with the actual situation.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 以為 to introduce an erroneous preconception.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以為 is followed by the speaker's original idea, which is different from what happened later. 沒想到 is followed by the fact that has already happened but which the speaker had not thought about beforehand.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Propose a preferred suggestion or wise compromise after weighing different options with ……，還是……吧.
grammarPages.explanation: 說話的人比較了不同情況以後，做出結論或提出建議。「還是」後面是提出的建議。

columns.meaning: ending word that makes a suggestion
connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing
ending word that makes a suggestion
ending word that makes a suggestion

text.traditional: ……，你還是先買收音機，再去超市吧。
text.simplified: ……，你还是先买收音机，再去超市吧。
text.pinyin: ……, nǐ háishì xiān mǎi shōuyīnjī, zài qù chāoshì ba.
text.english: …You had better buy a radio first, then go to the supermarket.

words.meaning: ending word that makes a suggestion

text.traditional:
A：我想安排時間去日本旅行，你想什麼時候去最好？
B：日本春夏秋冬都美，任何時候去都好，你還是以自己方便的時間去吧。
text.simplified:
A：我想安排时间去日本旅行，你想什么时候去最好？
B：日本春夏秋冬都美，任何时候去都好，你还是以自己方便的时间去吧。
text.pinyin:
A:wǒ xiǎng ānpái shíjiān qù Rìběn lǚxíng, nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhòu qù zuì hǎo?
B:Rìběn chūn xià qiū dōng dōu měi, rènhé shíhou qù dōu hǎo, nǐ háishì yǐ zìjǐ fāngbiàn de shíjiān qù ba.
text.english: A: I want to arrange a trip to Japan. When do you think is best? B: Japan is beautiful in every season, so any time is good; you had better go when it is convenient for you.

text.traditional:
兒子：中秋節快到了，我可以找朋友來我們社區烤肉嗎？
爸爸：我擔心會影響鄰居的生活，你們還是去別的地方吧。
text.simplified:
儿子：中秋节快到了，我可以找朋友来我们社区烤肉吗？
爸爸：我担心会影响邻居的生活，你们还是去别的地方吧。
text.pinyin:
Érzi:Zhōngqiūjié kuài dào le, wǒ kěyǐ zhǎo péngyǒu lái wǒmen shèqū kǎoròu ma?
Bàba:wǒ dānxīn huì yǐngxiǎng línjū de shēnghuó, nǐmen háishì qù bié de dìfang ba.
text.english: Son: The Mid-Autumn Festival is coming. May I invite friends to our community for a barbecue? Dad: I worry it will disturb the neighbors; you had better go somewhere else.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes-or-no question
ending word that makes a suggestion

items.question: How does 還是……吧 differ from 或者?
items.answer: 或者 presents open alternatives without favoring one. 還是……吧 presents the speaker's definitive recommendation.
items.wrongTraditional: 外面風雨大，你或者坐我的車。
items.wrongSimplified: 外面风雨大，你或者坐我的车。

right.traditional: 外面風雨大，你還是坐我的車吧。
right.simplified: 外面风雨大，你还是坐我的车吧。
right.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēngyǔ dà, nǐ háishì zuò wǒ de chē ba.
right.english: The storm is fierce outside; you had better ride in my car.

items.question: What tone does 吧 convey at the end of 還是……吧?
items.answer: 吧 softens the advice into a polite, consultative suggestion rather than an imperative command.

right.pinyin: Nǐ háishì xiān qù yīyuàn ba.
right.english: You'd better go to the hospital first.

tiles.pinyin: háishì liú zài jiā lǐ ba
huòzhě liú zài jiā lǐ ma
yěxǔ liú zài jiā lǐ le

questions.correctFeedback: 還是……吧 offers the wisest suggestion given the severe storm.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 還是……吧 to propose a preferable recommendation.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The person speaking compares the different situations, then makes conclusions or suggestions. 還是 is followed by such suggestions.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 九二一大地震 · The September 21st Earthquake
grammarFocus: 方位詞：以東/以西/以南/以北

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 臺灣、印尼、日本等海島國家，整年大小地震不斷。研究人員認為，地震的主要原因是地理位置在太平洋周圍的關係。對住在這個地帶的人來說，地震好像是很平常的事情。不過，一九九九年九月二十一日，半夜一點四十七分，臺灣發生了一場規模七點三的強烈地震。地震發生時，讓臺灣人感覺到非常害怕。大約過了三十分鐘，又發生了規模六點七的地震，結果造成了非常嚴重的災情。一直到現在，人們還是忘不了那個可怕的夜晚。
lines.simplified: 台湾、印尼、日本等海岛国家，整年大小地震不断。研究人员认为，地震的主要原因是地理位置在太平洋周围的关系。对住在这个地带的人来说，地震好像是很平常的事情。不过，一九九九年九月二十一日，半夜一点四十七分，台湾发生了一场规模七点三的强烈地震。地震发生时，让台湾人感觉到非常害怕。大约过了三十分钟，又发生了规模六点七的地震，结果造成了非常严重的灾情。一直到现在，人们还是忘不了那个可怕的夜晚。
lines.pinyin: Táiwān, Yìnní, Rìběn děng hǎidǎo guójiā, zhěng nián dàxiǎo dìzhèn búduàn. Yánjiū rényuán rènwéi, dìzhèn de zhǔyào yuányīn shì dìlǐ wèizhì zài Tàipíngyáng zhōuwéi de guānxi. Duì zhù zài zhè ge dìdài de rén lái shuō, dìzhèn hǎoxiàng shì hěn píngcháng de shìqing. Búguò, yī jiǔ jiǔ jiǔ nián jiǔ yuè èrshíyī rì, bànyè yì diǎn sìshíqī fēn, Táiwān fāshēng le yì chǎng guīmó qī diǎn sān de qiángliè dìzhèn. Dìzhèn fāshēng shí, ràng Táiwānrén gǎnjué dào fēicháng hàipà. Dàyuē guò le sānshí fēnzhōng, yòu fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn qī de dìzhèn, jiéguǒ zàochéng le fēicháng yánzhòng de zāiqíng. Yìzhí dào xiànzài, rénmen háishì wàng buliǎo nà ge kěpà de yèwǎn.
lines.english: Island nations such as Taiwan, Indonesia, and Japan experience continuous earthquakes of all sizes throughout the year. Researchers believe the primary cause of earthquakes is their geographical location around the Pacific Ocean. To people living in this zone, earthquakes seem to be quite ordinary. However, on September 21, 1999, at 1:47 a.m., Taiwan experienced a powerful magnitude 7.3 earthquake. When the earthquake struck, it made Taiwanese people feel terrified. About thirty minutes later, another magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck, resulting in extremely severe devastation. Even now, people still cannot forget that terrifying night.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 那一夜，中部山區有許多大石頭從山上掉了下來，不但路不通，甚至還有人被困在塌下來的屋子或石頭底下。許多人親眼看見這樣的情況，但是沒辦法把人救出來，只能向警察或軍人求救。不久，救災人員和軍隊都到達了災區，不少國外的專業人員也都趕到臺灣，大家把力量集合起來，很有耐心地找出被困的人。
lines.simplified: 那一夜，中部山区有许多大石头从山上掉了下来，不但路不通，甚至还有人被困在塌下来的屋子或石头底下。许多人亲眼看见这样的情况，但是没办法把人救出来，只能向警察或军人求救。不久，救灾人员和军队都到达了灾区，不少国外的专业人员也都赶到台湾，大家把力量集合起来，很有耐心地找出被困的人。
lines.pinyin: Nà yí yè, zhōngbù shānqū yǒu xǔduō dà shítóu cóng shānshàng diào le xiàlai, búdàn lù bù tōng, shènzhì hái yǒurén bèi kùn zài tā xiàlai de wūzi huò shítóu dǐxia. Xǔduō rén qīnyǎn kànjiàn zhèyàng de qíngkuàng, dànshì méi bànfǎ bǎ rén jiù chūlai, zhǐ néng xiàng jǐngchá huò jūnrén qiújiù. Bùjiǔ, jiùzāi rényuán hàn jūnduì dōu dàodá le zāiqū, bù shǎo guówài de zhuānyè rényuán yě dōu gǎndào Táiwān, dàjiā bǎ lìliàng jíhé qǐlai, hěn yǒu nàixīn de zhǎochū bèi kùn de rén.
lines.english: That night, in the central mountainous area, many huge boulders fell from the mountains; not only were roads blocked, but some people were even trapped under collapsed houses or rocks. Many people saw this situation with their own eyes, but had no way to rescue the victims, and could only call for help from police or soldiers. Soon, disaster relief personnel and troops arrived in the disaster area, and quite a few overseas specialists also rushed to Taiwan; everyone combined their efforts and patiently searched for the trapped survivors.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 地震過後沒多久，人們發現中部以北和以南的地方也有不少災情，所以天還沒亮，許多民眾就開著卡車，把水、食物、電池等資源送到災區，親自發給需要的人。那段時間，因為大家有錢出錢、有力出力，發揮了互相幫助的精神，所以才能讓災民很快地恢復正常的生活。
lines.simplified: 地震过后没多久，人们发现中部以北和以南的地方也有不少灾情，所以天还没亮，许多民众就开着卡车，把水、食物、电池等资源送到灾区，亲自发给需要的人。那段时间，因为大家有钱出钱、有力出力，发挥了互相帮助的精神，所以才能让灾民很快地恢复正常的生活。
lines.pinyin: Dìzhèn guòhòu méi duōjiǔ, rénmen fāxiàn zhōngbù yǐ běi hàn yǐ nán de dìfang yě yǒu bù shǎo zāiqíng, suǒyǐ tiān hái méi liàng, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù kāi zhe kǎchē, bǎ shuǐ, shíwù, diànchí děng zīyuán sòng dào zāiqū, qīnzì fā gěi xūyào de rén. Nà duàn shíjiān, yīnwèi dàjiā yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, fāhuī le hùxiāng bāngzhù de jīngshén, suǒyǐ cái néng ràng zāimín hěn kuài de huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
lines.english: Not long after the earthquake, people found that areas north and south of the central region also suffered considerable damage; therefore before dawn, many citizens drove trucks to deliver water, food, batteries, and other resources to the disaster area, personally distributing them to people in need. During that period, because everyone contributed money if they had money, and effort if they had effort, embodying the spirit of mutual help, the victims were able to quickly resume normal life.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 經過九二一大地震以後，臺灣比以前更重視地震教育，希望這樣能降低災情，人們不要再因為地震而失去了寶貴的生命。
lines.simplified: 经过九二一大地震以后，台湾比以前更重视地震教育，希望这样能降低灾情，人们不要再因为地震而失去了宝贵的生命。
lines.pinyin: Jīngguò Jiǔ'èryī dà dìzhèn yǐhòu, Táiwān bǐ yǐqián gèng zhòngshì dìzhèn jiàoyù, xīwàng zhèyàng néng jiàngdī zāiqíng, rénmen bú yào zài yīnwèi dìzhèn ér shīqù le bǎoguì de shēngmìng.
lines.english: Following the 921 Earthquake, Taiwan attached greater importance to earthquake education than before, hoping to reduce disaster impact so people will never again lose precious lives because of earthquakes.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: As a Result, In the End
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect an event to its unexpected or ultimate outcome using the conjunction 結果.
grammarPages.explanation: 「結果」作連詞，表示事情發生後，最後的情況。「結果」後面接的句子是這件事情最後的情況。

columns.meaning: connects a describing word to a thing; can stand for a known thing

text.traditional: ……又發生了規模六點七的地震，結果造成了非常嚴重的災情……
text.simplified: ……又发生了规模六点七的地震，结果造成了非常严重的灾情……
text.pinyin: …… yòu fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn qī de dìzhèn, jiéguǒ zàochéng le fēicháng yánzhòng de zāiqíng……
text.english: …Another magnitude 6.7 earthquake occurred, resulting in very serious disaster damage…

text.traditional: 昨天我在夜市看上了一件上衣，沒試穿就買了，結果回家後穿上才發現太小了。
text.simplified: 昨天我在夜市看上了一件上衣，没试穿就买了，结果回家后穿上才发现太小了。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān wǒ zài yèshì kàn shàng le yí jiàn shàngyī, méi shìchuān jiù mǎi le, jiéguǒ huí jiā hòu chuān shàng cái fāxiàn tài xiǎo le.
text.english: Yesterday I liked a top at the night market and bought it without trying it on; when I got home and put it on, I found it was too small.

words.meaning: be in the middle of an action; at

text.traditional: 這幾個月很多人因為感冒而住院了，我和家人出門都會戴上口罩，結果妹妹還是感冒了。
text.simplified: 这几个月很多人因为感冒而住院了，我和家人出门都会戴上口罩，结果妹妹还是感冒了。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè hěn duō rén yīnwèi gǎnmào ér zhùyuàn le, wǒ hé jiārén chūmén dōu huì dài shàng kǒuzhào, jiéguǒ mèimei háishì gǎnmào le.
text.english: Many people have been hospitalized with colds these past few months, so my family and I wear masks when we go out; my younger sister still caught a cold.

items.question: How does 結果 differ from 所以?
items.answer: 所以 expresses logical cause-and-effect. 結果 emphasizes the ultimate outcome, often contrary to hopes or plans.
items.wrongTraditional: 他很努力準備，所以考試沒及格。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很努力准备，所以考试没及格。

right.traditional: 他很努力準備，結果考試沒及格。
right.simplified: 他很努力准备，结果考试没及格。
right.pinyin: Tā hěn nǔlì zhǔnbèi, jiéguǒ kǎoshì méi jígé.
right.english: He prepared diligently; in the end, he failed the exam.

items.question: Can 結果 serve as both noun and conjunction?
items.answer: Yes, as a noun it means 'outcome' (考試的結果); as a conjunction it links clauses ('as a result, ...').
items.wrongTraditional: 這件事情的結果是我們結果遲到了。
items.wrongSimplified: 这件事情的结果是我们结果迟到了。

right.traditional: 路上塞車，結果我們遲到了。
right.simplified: 路上塞车，结果我们迟到了。
right.pinyin: Lùshàng sāichē, jiéguǒ wǒmen chídào le.
right.english: There was a traffic jam on the road, and as a result we were late.

segments.hint: as a result was late this morning

tiles.meaning: as a result late this morning

questions.correctFeedback: 結果 marks the final unforeseen consequence of not setting an alarm.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 結果 to introduce the ultimate outcome.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 結果 is a conjunction indicating the final situation after an event has occurred. The sentence after 結果 is the final condition of this matter.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight an unexpected extreme or surprising addition using 甚至(連)……也/都……
grammarPages.explanation: 「甚至」後面是說話的人要強調的人、事或物。有時和「不但/不僅」或「連……都/也……」一起使用，例如：我姊姊不但會唱歌，也會寫歌，甚至辦過個人演唱會。

text.traditional: ……不但路不通，甚至還有人被困在塌下來的屋子或石頭底下。
text.simplified: ……不但路不通，甚至还有人被困在塌下来的屋子或石头底下。
text.pinyin: …… búdàn lù bù tōng, shènzhì hái yǒurén bèi kùn zài tā xiàlai de wūzi huò shítou dǐxià.
text.english: …Not only were roads blocked, but people were even trapped under collapsed houses or rocks.

text.traditional: 張小姐什麼動物都不怕，就是怕蛇，甚至連蛇的圖片也怕。
text.simplified: 张小姐什么动物都不怕，就是怕蛇，甚至连蛇的图片也怕。
text.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě shénme dòngwù dōu bú pà, jiùshì pà shé, shènzhì lián shé de túpiàn yě pà.
text.english: Miss Zhang is not afraid of any animal except snakes; she is even afraid of pictures of snakes.

text.traditional: 馬老闆一忙起來，不但沒空吃飯，甚至連上廁所的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 马老板一忙起来，不但没空吃饭，甚至连上厕所的时间都没有。
text.pinyin: Mǎ lǎobǎn yì máng qǐlai, búdàn méi kòng chīfàn, shènzhì lián shàng cèsuǒ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: When Boss Ma gets busy, he not only has no time to eat but does not even have time to use the toilet.

items.question: How does 甚至 differ from 而且?
items.answer: 而且 adds parallel information. 甚至 adds an extreme, surprising case that escalates the degree.
items.wrongTraditional: 他會很多外語，而且會說古希臘語。
items.wrongSimplified: 他会很多外语，而且会说古希腊语。

right.traditional: 他會很多外語，甚至會說古希臘語。
right.simplified: 他会很多外语，甚至会说古希腊语。
right.pinyin: Tā huì hěn duō wàiyǔ, shènzhì huì shuō Gǔ Xīlàyǔ.
right.english: He knows many languages, and can even speak Ancient Greek.

items.question: When 甚至 pairs with 連, where does 連 go?
items.answer: 連 directly follows 甚至: 甚至連 + noun + 也/都.
items.wrongTraditional: 連他甚至名字都記不住。
items.wrongSimplified: 连他甚至名字都记不住。

right.traditional: 他甚至連名字都記不住。
right.simplified: 他甚至连名字都记不住。
right.pinyin: Tā shènzhì lián míngzi dōu jì bu zhù.

questions.correctFeedback: 甚至連……都…… emphasizes the extreme surprise that even their own parents mistake them.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 甚至連……都…… to express an extreme unexpected degree.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The sentence following 甚至 is the main emphasis, which can be the person, the thing, or the object that the speaker wants to emphasize. It is often used with 不但 or 連……都/也……. For example, 我姊姊不但會唱歌，也會寫歌，甚至辦過個人演唱會.

grammarPages.titleTraditional: 方位詞：以東/以西/以南/以北
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Specify geographic areas relative to a reference point using 以東/以西/以南/以北.
grammarPages.explanation: 「以」表示方位的界限。「以」的前面放地區或是地名，例如：「臺中以北」意思是「臺中」為界限的北方。
grammarPages.pattern: Reference Point + 以 (東/西/南/北) + (的地區)

text.traditional: 地震過後沒多久，人們發現中部以北和以南的地方也有不少災情。
text.simplified: 地震过后没多久，人们发现中部以北和以南的地方也有不少灾情。
text.pinyin: Dìzhèn guò hòu méi duōjiǔ, rénmen fāxiàn zhōngbù yǐ běi hàn yǐ nán de dìfang yě yǒu bù shǎo zāiqíng.
text.english: Not long after the earthquake, people found considerable damage in places both north and south of the central region.

text.traditional: 車站以北的地區比其他地區熱鬧，如果你想逛街購物，那裡真是個好地方。
text.simplified: 车站以北的地区比其他地区热闹，如果你想逛街购物，那里真是个好地方。
text.pinyin: Chēzhàn yǐ běi de dìqū bǐ qítā dìqū rènao, rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng guàngjiē gòuwù, nàlǐ zhēnshì ge hǎo dìfang.
text.english: The area north of the station is livelier than other areas; if you want to go shopping, it is a great place.

text.traditional: 我覺得花蓮市以南到臺東這一段路的風景最美，值得推薦給喜歡旅遊的人。
text.simplified: 我觉得花莲市以南到台东这一段路的风景最美，值得推荐给喜欢旅游的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde Huālián shì yǐ nán dào Táidōng zhè yí duàn lù de fēngjǐng zuì měi, zhídé tuījiàn gěi xǐhuān lǚyóu de rén.
text.english: I think the scenery on the stretch south of Hualien City to Taitung is the most beautiful and worth recommending to people who like traveling.

items.question: How does 臺北以南 differ from 臺北的南方?
items.answer: 臺北以南 describes an open regional zone starting from Taipei and heading south. 臺北的南方 refers to a specific direction or location south of Taipei.
items.wrongTraditional: 火車站的西方房子比較便宜。
items.wrongSimplified: 火车站的西方房子比较便宜。

right.traditional: 火車站以西的房子比較便宜。
right.simplified: 火车站以西的房子比较便宜。
right.pinyin: Huǒchēzhàn yǐ xī de fángzi bǐjiào piányi.
right.english: Apartments west of the train station are cheaper.

items.question: Can 以 be combined with any single directional compass word?
items.answer: Yes: 以東 (east of), 以西 (west of), 以南 (south of), 以北 (north of).
items.wrongTraditional: 中部往北的地方也有災情。
items.wrongSimplified: 中部往北的地方也有灾情。

right.traditional: 中部以北的地方也有災情。
right.simplified: 中部以北的地方也有灾情。
right.pinyin: Zhōngbù yǐ běi de dìfang yě yǒu zāiqíng.
right.english: Areas north of the central region also experienced disaster damage.

questions.correctFeedback: 火車站以西 indicates the geographic region extending westward from the station.
questions.repairFeedback: Use 基點 + 以 + 方向 (東/西/南/北) to specify a regional boundary.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以 indicates the boundary of a place. Place the name of an area or location in front of 以. For example, 臺中以北 means north of the boundary of 臺中.
